## Part A - Arithmetic operations

```{r}
a <- 17
b <- 5
a+b
a-b
a*b
a/b
```
```{r}
a <- 17
b <- 5
a%%b
a%/%b
```
```{r}
2 ^ 10
```
## Part B - Basic Data Types: typeof(), class(), and mode()

```{r}
x <- 42
y <- 42L        # the L suffix forces an integer
z <- "42"
w <- TRUE
v <- 3 + 2i     # complex number
typeof(x)
typeof(y)
typeof(z)
typeof(w)
typeof(v)
```
```{r}
x <- 42
y <- 42L        # the L suffix forces an integer
z <- "42"
w <- TRUE
v <- 3 + 2i     # complex number
class(x)
class(y)
class(z)
class(w)
class(v)
```
```{r}
x <- 42
y <- 42L        # the L suffix forces an integer
z <- "42"
w <- TRUE
v <- 3 + 2i     # complex number
mode(x)
mode(y)
mode(z)
mode(w)
mode(v)
```
## Part C - Type Conversion
```{r}
num_string <- "123"
as.numeric("123")
typeof(num_string)
class(num_string)
mode(num_string)
```
```{r}
num <- 0
num2 <- 1
as.logical(0)
as.logical(1)
```
```{r}
bad_string <- "hello123"
as.numeric("hello123")
```
## Part D - Strings paste(), and paste0()

```{r}
first_name <- "Juan"
last_name <- "Dela Cruz"
full_name <- cat(first_name,last_name)
```
```{r}
first_name <- "Juan"
last_name <- "Dela Cruz"
name <- paste("my name is", first_name,last_name)
name
name <- paste0("my name is", first_name,last_name)
name
```
```{r}
first_name <- "Juan  "
last_name <- "Dela Cruz"
name <- paste("my name is", first_name,last_name, sep = "-")
name
```
```{r}
first_name <- "Juan"
last_name <- "Dela Cruz"
age <- 21 
name <- paste0( first_name,last_name, "is ", age, "years old")
name
```
